title: Jolt Physics fails to correctly scale StaticBody3D
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.5
- Not tested in any other versions

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL ES 3/ANGLE (Compatibility) - ANGLE (Intel, Intel(R) HD Graphics 5500 (0x00001616) Direct3D11 vs_5_0 ps_5_0, D3D11-20.19.15.5171) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-5005U CPU @ 2.00GHz (4 threads) - 7.92 GiB memory

### Issue description

While using Jolt Physics for my project, it fails to correctly scale StaticBody3D. I have a few of them & I get:
```
 ERROR: modules/jolt_physics/objects/jolt_shaped_object_3d.cpp:72 - Failed to correctly scale body 'StaticBody3D:<StaticBody3D#2279335872819>'. A scale of (1.697926, 1.542503, 1.726272) is not supported by Jolt Physics for this shape/body. The scale will instead be treated as (1.655567, 1.655567, 1.655567).
  ERROR: modules/jolt_physics/objects/jolt_shaped_object_3d.cpp:72 - Failed to correctly scale body 'StaticBody3D:<StaticBody3D#2279335872819>'. A scale of (1.697926, 1.542503, 1.726272) is not supported by Jolt Physics for this shape/body. The scale will instead be treated as (1.655567, 1.655567, 1.655567).
  ERROR: modules/jolt_physics/objects/jolt_shaped_object_3d.cpp:72 - Failed to correctly scale body 'StaticBody3D:<StaticBody3D#2279335872819>'. A scale of (1.697926, 1.542503, 1.726272) is not supported by Jolt Physics for this shape/body. The scale will instead be treated as (1.655567, 1.655567, 1.655567).
  ERROR: modules/jolt_physics/objects/jolt_shaped_object_3d.cpp:72 - Failed to correctly scale body 'StaticBody3D:<StaticBody3D#2279335872819>'. A scale of (1.697926, 1.542503, 1.726272) is not supported by Jolt Physics for this shape/body. The scale will instead be treated as (1.655567, 1.655567, 1.655567).
  ERROR: modules/jolt_physics/objects/jolt_shaped_object_3d.cpp:72 - Failed to correctly scale body 'StaticBody3D:<StaticBody3D#2279335872819>'. A scale of (1.697926, 1.542503, 1.726272) is not supported by Jolt Physics for this shape/body. The scale will instead be treated as (1.655567, 1.655567, 1.655567).
```
It will keep happening, even when I reopen the scene. This didn't occur in Godot's Physics Engine so I believe it is something Jolt specific.

### Steps to reproduce

Make a StaticBody3D & use Jolt Physics. Set the scale higher than what Jolt can handle & you should get this. This issue isn't serious but it's a bit annoying having this error spam my output console.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Have a look at the steps to reproduce instead :)
